# activedirectory_group_member (Resource)

A single group membership edge — a non-authoritative membership. Each resource manages exactly one member of one group and leaves every other member untouched, so several may target the same group and out-of-band members are never removed. To own a group's whole member set instead, use `activedirectory_group_membership`; do not manage the same group with both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Non-authoritative: manage a single membership edge. Other members of the group
# are left untouched.
resource "activedirectory_group_member" "alice_in_devs" {
  group_id  = activedirectory_group.devs.id
  member_id = activedirectory_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group's objectGUID. Changing it replaces the edge (the old membership is removed and the new one added); an edge holds no SID or ACL, so unlike the object resources this is a replace rather than a move.
- `member_id` (String) The member's objectGUID (a user, group, computer or other security principal). Changing it replaces the edge.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<group objectGUID>/<member objectGUID>`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import one edge by "<group objectGUID>/<member objectGUID>".
terraform import activedirectory_group_member.alice_in_devs \
  11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
```
